title: Post-Extraction Wound Healing in Elderly
summary: Patients presenting to the University of Nebraska Medical Center College of Dentistry for a posterior extraction will be offered participation in the study. Prior to extraction, subjects will undergo clinical measurements, xray, gingival crevicular fluid (GCF) and saliva sampling and a blood draw. Following atraumatic tooth extraction, the subjects will be reevaluated for healing at 1, 2-weeks and 3 months. At each appointment, GCF, saliva and wound fluid (WF) will be collected and at 3 months a second xray will be taken.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* needs posterior tooth extracted
* no systemic conditions or meds affecting wound healing
* non-smoker

Exclusion Criteria:

* systemic conditions or meds known to affect wound healing
* smokers
